description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git blame' command, specifically focusing on ignoring revisions, handling revisions from files, config options, and edge cases in blame heuristic behaviors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case that should fail.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Helper function to write multiple lines to a file.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Creates a new commit or advances the test environment to simulate changes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two outputs or files.
